info.name: Hotel Offer Orchestrator
info.description: Health, supplier, orchestration, Redis price-filtering, and validation requests.

exec: pm.test('Supplier hotel shape', () => body.forEach(h => { pm.expect(h).to.have.all.keys('hotelId', 'name', 'price', 'city', 'commissionPct'); pm.expect(h.price).to.be.a('number'); }));
pm.test('Offer response shape', () => body.forEach(h => { pm.expect(h).to.have.all.keys('name', 'price', 'supplier', 'commissionPct'); pm.expect(h.price).to.be.a('number'); }));
pm.test('No normalized duplicate names', () => { const names = body.map(h => h.name.trim().toLowerCase()); pm.expect(new Set(names).size).to.eql(names.length); });
pm.test('Ascending price order', () => { for (let i = 1; i < body.length; i++) pm.expect(body[i].price).to.be.at.least(body[i - 1].price); });
if (name === 'Hotels - Unknown City') pm.test('Unknown city is empty', () => pm.expect(body).to.eql([]));
if (name === 'Hotels - Minimum Price') pm.test('Inclusive minimum', () => { body.forEach(h => pm.expect(h.price).to.be.at.least(5900)); pm.expect(body.some(h => h.price === 5900)).to.be.true; });
if (name === 'Hotels - Maximum Price') pm.test('Inclusive maximum', () => { body.forEach(h => pm.expect(h.price).to.be.at.most(5900)); pm.expect(body.some(h => h.price === 5900)).to.be.true; });

if (name === 'Hotels - Inclusive Price Range') pm.test('Both boundaries included', () => { body.forEach(h => pm.expect(h.price).to.be.within(5340, 5900)); pm.expect(body.some(h => h.price === 5340)).to.be.true; pm.expect(body.some(h => h.price === 5900)).to.be.true; });
